title: allow to display examples in the documentation website
body:
Currently the documentation website is fully static. We need to be able to show examples in every pages: widgets, guide, complete examples.

The website is using metalsmith. Starting with widget examples can be good.

comments.body: We are good now at showing live examples, but we still need to be able to show live widget examples. Basically we need to rethink how we document widgets here now
We already have an issue about widget examples #1238
